question: What was the root cause of the April security incident with the exposed FleetSight token?
reference_answer: Incident SEC-ACME-2026-0417 was caused by a long-lived static FleetSight gateway service token with overly broad read scope that a contractor committed in plaintext to a CI config in a public personal fork of fleetsight-edge-sim; because the fork was outside the Acme GitHub organization, secret scanning never ran on it.
evidence: | Incident ID | SEC-ACME-2026-0417 |

The root cause was a long-lived static FleetSight gateway service token, with far broader read scope than the job needed, that a contractor committed in plaintext to a CI configuration file in a personal fork of the fleetsight-edge-sim repository; because the fork lived outside the Acme GitHub organization, our secret scanning never ran on it.
